posts.title: Because this week … it’s all about the bird!
posts.description: It’s also all about remaining calm as Thanksgiving approaches, then, for some, it becomes a whirlwind of activity until 2027 arrives. So, I chose this post accordingly … a little tranquility for you with a sailboat or two or three and a few birds. If you’re looking for turkeys, well you won’t find them today, but you will on Wednesday. Every year, from Spring until early Fall, I make regular treks along the Cove Point shoreline at Lake Erie Metropark trying to get good Osprey pictures. I decided 2026 was my year to monitor the Osprey and their offspring. Those thoughts intensified when, once again, I realized the pair of Sandhill Cranes were still MIA and it appeared Mrs. Mute Swan did not intend to build a nest in the same place, within gawking, er … viewing distance near the Offshore Fishing Bridge.
